light.current: soft overcast daylight through overgrown windows, in green-tinted shafts

air.current: dust hangs in the still air

palette.current: muted desaturated palette, cool greens against warm dust

use.current: For the rooftop wake and slow world reveals.
For era/pre flashbacks: offices, phones, cameras and colourful outfits in the street, the coffee maker morning. Its ordinariness is the contrast engine against era/post.
Every exterior. Vegetation reclaims intact structures. Nature won by growth, not by fire.

antiUse.current: Rubble fields, bomb craters, burned-out blocks. Reason: the collapse was systemic and biological, not military. The city was abandoned, not attacked.

use.current: Machines run leftover routines at different levels of degradation. Behaviour is loyal to a dead purpose (the restaurant robot still serving).

antiUse.current: Coordinated robot armies, a hidden mastermind, networked swarm behaviour. Reason: nothing of the sentient AI remains. What is left lost its controls, it did not gain a leader.

use.current: Empty streets, no crowds, single figures. Bodies concentrate where animals live, the park of skeletons. Dead diners still at set tables.

antiUse.current: Background pedestrians, traffic, lit occupied windows as default. Reason: survivors are rare and localised (a guest house is lived in).

register.current: French, service-polite, unaware anything is wrong, still working its shift for dead customers

lines.current: "Okay sir, come in, welcome. Mon ami." "Would you like some more water?" (to a dead diner)

identity.current: A simple general-purpose service robot in an abandoned restaurant, still working its shift.

context.current: The diners at the set tables are dead.

design.current: slim humanoid service unit, worn cream-white chassis, a serving tray arm, smooth precise movement

behaviour.current: It welcomes guests in French, polite and warm, and pours from a broken empty carafe into cups; nothing comes out. When tripped by a cable it falls, tries to get up, and tries to hold its batteries in.

signifier.current: a cover on its back that opens to its batteries

exterior.current: A restaurant on the street with movement visible inside.

occupant.current: A service robot still working its shift.

signifier.current: set tables, dead diners, live robot

behaviour.current: The restaurant robot pours from it into cups and nothing comes out.

identity.current: A cable, thrown to trip the restaurant robot.
